name: find-session
description: Full-text search across Claude Code and Codex sessions in every project, with resume commands

claudeDirs.title: Claude config folders
claudeDirs.description: Claude Code config folders to search, e.g. ~/.claude. Add =<command> to set the resume launcher: ~/.claude-work=claude-work. Empty: ~/.claude, $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and any other ~/.claude* folder with a projects/ folder.

codexDir.title: Codex sessions folder
codexDir.description: Folder holding Codex session logs. Empty: $CODEX_HOME/sessions, else ~/.codex/sessions. Set to 'off' to skip Codex.

limit.title: Results shown
limit.description: How many sessions to list when no limit is typed after the term.

python.title: Python command
python.description: Python 3 executable that runs the search, e.g. python on Windows.
